MIND. [1] [Cop.]
General sense of uneasiness ; depression.
Delirium. θ Urticaria.
   

SENSORIUM. [2] [Cop.]
Delirium, intense headache, drowsiness, embarrassed speech. θ Urticaria.
Vertigo.
   

INNER HEAD. [3] [Cop.]
Violent headache. θ Urticaria.
Headache as from congestion, with heat in face and sensation of trembling in head ; delirium.
Headache and general malaise, with chills. θ Nettlerash.
   

SIGHT AND EYES. [5] [Cop.]
Inflammation and itching of eyes ; dim-sightedness.
   

SMELL AND NOSE. [7] [Cop.]
Severe spontaneous epistaxis of small boys, lasting several days.
Epistaxis ; hemorrhages after wounds.
(OBS :) Profuse, yellow and green, thick, fetid discharge from nasal passages of several years' duration ; at night the discharge runs down posterior nares, causing choking and other disagreeable symptoms. θ Chronic nasal catarrh.
   

UPPER FACE. [8] [Cop.]
Flushed face, interspersed with rose-colored spots. θ Urticaria.
Red face and urticaria over whole body ; face, eyelids, lips, ears and hands swollen.
Acne which had for a long time disfigured face. θ Urinary troubles.
   

TASTE, SPEECH, TONGUE. [11] [Cop.]
Speech embarrassed, cannot talk well. θ Urticaria.
Tongue coated white. θ Bronchial and vesical catarrh.
   

INNER MOUTH. [12] [Cop.]
Pain in mouth, throat and joints.
Slight but painful swelling of lips and mouth.
Dryness of tongue, with inflammation of throat and mouth.
Increased flow of saliva.
   

PALATE AND THROAT. [13] [Cop.]
Chronic inflammation of throat.
Marked inflammation of throat with great swelling of submaxillary glands and threatened suffocation.
   

APPETITE, THIRST. DESIRES, AVERSIONS. [14] [Cop.]
Loss of appetite. θ Bronchial and vesical catarrh. θ Urticaria.
Great thirst. θ Urticaria.
   

HICCOUGH, BELCHING, NAUSEA AND VOMITING. [16] [Cop.]
Eructations, excessive nausea ; nausea in throat ; gagging and vomiting.
Great nausea with severe colic, somewhat > by sweat.
Spitting up of ingesta, with large quantities of mucus ; sometimes vomiting of mucus. θ Gastric catarrh.
